name: Sorein Foldable Solar Panel
product_summary: Sorein Foldable Solar Panel is a portable solar charging panel that adds off-grid charging support for compatible equipment.
verified_facts: The Sorein Foldable Solar Panel pairs with any Sorein Modular Power System configuration for portable solar charging, available in 100W, 200W, and 400W versions. Built with A+ Grade Advanced Monocrystalline cells rated up to 24% efficiency. IP67 waterproof and dustproof with a durable ETFE coating, and a kickstand with adjustable angles of 35, 45, and 55 degrees. Feeds up to 1,000W of combined solar input into a Sorein Main Base setup.
